messages.body:
Dear all
I have successfully ran simulations for thermodynamic integration using
AMBER20.
However, when I try to run analysis, I get the following errors
/home/eph/.local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/pymbar/bar.py:467:
RuntimeWarning: divide by zero encountered in log
log_fF = - np.log(np.exp(-max_arg_F) + np.exp(exp_arg_F - max_arg_F))
/home/eph/.local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/pymbar/utils.py:324:
RuntimeWarning: overflow encountered in exp
out = np.log(np.sum(np.exp(a - a_max), axis=axis))
/home/eph/.local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/numpy/core/fromnumeric.py:87:
RuntimeWarning: overflow encountered in reduce
return ufunc.reduce(obj, axis, dtype, out, **passkwargs)
/home/eph/.local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/pymbar/bar.py:482:
RuntimeWarning: invalid value encountered in double_scalars
variance = (afF2/afF**2)/T_F + (afR2/afR**2)/T_R - nrat
Could not calculate overlap matrix

Thank you in advance.
Regards.
